image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light suspended against a clear blue sky. The traffic light housing is dark gray/black with three circular lenses stacked vertically: red (top, illuminated), amber (middle, unlit but visible), and green (bottom, illuminated). Each lens has a textured, faceted surface typical of LED arrays or prismatic lenses. Visors extend over each lens. The unit is mounted to a horizontal mast arm via a bracket, with utility wires visible in the background.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity and rule out misclassification as other street furniture.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the visors and the depth separation between the housing and the background sky/wires.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the dark housing and the bright blue sky, especially around the visors.
To analyze the realism of the illuminated LEDs and the texture of the lens covers for any AI-generated smoothing or noise artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the illumination of the red and green lights. In AI images, 'glowing' lights often lack proper bloom or cast unrealistic light on the housing. Check if the amber lens looks physically distinct even when unlit. Verify that the mounting bracket connects logically to the mast arm without melting or floating.
